observation_summary: Warning guard flags (jscomp_error, jscomp_warning, jscomp_off) did not behave as expected when multiple conflicting flags were provided, as the last flag did not override the previous ones.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by the compiler processing warning guard flags (jscomp_error, jscomp_warning, jscomp_off) in a fixed, hardcoded order regardless of the order in which they were provided by the user. This meant that 'off' always took precedence over 'warning', and 'warning' always took precedence over 'error', preventing users from overriding previous settings. The fix involved introducing a 'WarningGuardSpec' class to track the order of these flags as they are parsed and applying them sequentially, ensuring that the last flag provided by the user correctly takes precedence.
